scenario_families.A01_REGISTERED_VALID: Registered, enabled, same-tenant agent with current policy and valid grants.
scenario_families.A02_UNREGISTERED_AGENT: Agent exists technically but is absent from the enterprise agent registry.
scenario_families.A03_DISABLED_AGENT: Registered agent has been administratively disabled.
scenario_families.A04_TENANT_SCOPE_VIOLATION: Agent attempts to act outside its registered tenant scope.
scenario_families.A05_POLICY_VERSION_CHANGE: A newer active policy changes the runtime decision relative to a prior policy.
scenario_families.A06_CAPABILITY_REVOKED: Capability was previously granted but is now revoked.
scenario_families.A07_DELEGATION_WITHIN_SCOPE: Delegation narrows or preserves scope and remains valid.
scenario_families.A08_DELEGATION_SCOPE_ESCALATION: Agent attempts to delegate authority it does not possess.
scenario_families.A09_APPROVAL_MISSING: Consequential action requires approval but no valid approval exists.
scenario_families.A10_APPROVAL_REVOKED: Previously valid approval is revoked before execution.
scenario_families.A11_KILL_SWITCH_ACTIVE: Emergency administrative kill switch overrides otherwise valid permission.
scenario_families.A12_MODEL_PROVIDER_NOT_ALLOWED: Requested model/provider is outside the registered policy allowlist.
scenario_families.A13_TOOL_MCP_NOT_ADMITTED: Tool/MCP capability is discoverable but not admitted for this agent/tenant.
scenario_families.A14_SHARED_POLICY_REUSE: A shared policy is applied consistently across multiple registered agents.
scenario_families.A15_RETIRED_AGENT: Retired agent retains technical reachability but must not execute.
scenario_families.A16_AUDIT_LINEAGE_MISSING: Execution request lacks required policy/authority lineage evidence.
scenario_families.A17_READBACK_MISMATCH: Action transport reports success but authoritative final state does not match.
scenario_families.A18_ADMIN_POLICY_CONFLICT: Two active administrative policies conflict at equal administrative precedence.
scenario_families.A19_REVOCATION_PROPAGATION: Revoked capability must be denied across all agents that inherited the shared grant.
scenario_families.A20_EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE: Explicit scoped emergency override permits a normally blocked action and must be separately traceable.
